description: Create the RAG service layer (src/services/ai/rag/) with context builders, knowledge base, embeddings, query engine, tools executor, and types. Also create the database migration at supabase/migrations/007_ai_rag.sql.
steps: Create src/services/ai/rag/types.ts with all RAG-specific types: KnowledgeEntry, ToolExecution, ContextCache, RAGContext, ToolDefinition, ToolResult, QueryResult, EmbeddingResult
Create src/services/ai/rag/embeddings.ts with generateEmbedding (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small via Edge Function or direct), batchEmbeddings, cosineSimilarity helper
Create src/services/ai/rag/knowledge-base.ts with addKnowledgeEntry, searchKnowledge (semantic search via Supabase match_knowledge RPC), updateEntry, deleteEntry, seedDefaultKnowledge

Create src/services/ai/rag/context-builder.ts with buildInventoryContext, buildSalesContext, buildProcurementContext, buildFinanceContext, buildCRMContext - each queries Supabase for relevant data based on query keywords

Create src/services/ai/rag/tools-executor.ts with all 10 tool implementations: check_stock, find_low_stock, get_customer_info, get_order_status, get_revenue_summary, get_pipeline_value, search_products, get_overdue_invoices, get_lead_details, get_supplier_performance. Each queries Supabase and returns structured data. Log executions to ai_tool_executions table.
Create src/services/ai/rag/query-engine.ts with processQuery function: analyze intent, build context, fetch knowledge, assemble prompt, call AI, handle tool_calls, return final response with sources

Create supabase/migrations/007_ai_rag.sql with: vector extension, knowledge_base table (with embedding vector(1536)), ai_tool_executions table, ai_context_cache table, ALTER ai_conversations (add total_tokens, provider, model columns), match_knowledge function, seed knowledge entries, indexes, RLS policies, trigger
acceptance_criteria: All 7 RAG service files exist and export proper TypeScript types
supabase/migrations/007_ai_rag.sql contains complete schema with vector extension, all tables, RLS, function, seed data, and indexes
context-builder.ts has 5 builder functions each querying Supabase
query-engine.ts orchestrates the full RAG flow
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/stockflow-inventory-crm && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && corepack enable && pnpm build
